success_criteria: Every Section 5.3 tool family has a matrix row with user token, renderer key, visibility/location/inline/raw-json/state classification.

Fresh view_image, imagegen, and browser screenshot outputs show inline preview or explicit unavailable reason, proven by saved desktop/mobile artifacts.
Patch and generic fallback cards avoid duplicated header/raw JSON in the main flow.
Any restart/reload script path is verified before citation; /root/bin/safe-daemon-restart.sh is not named as available unless verification passes.
constraints: Do not modify code during BA phase.
Dev/QA must use dev web/API only, never production.
No API-created sessions; trigger content through UI or deterministic dev fixture route.
If CLI mapper reload is needed, subagents must use sandbox verification or stop with a user-run REQUEST.
No production/full restart script for dev rendering.
Live UI claims require durable screenshot/snapshot/DOM/trace artifacts; otherwise classify as unverified.
Before citing any restart/reload script path, verify exact path existence in the current environment.
